title: multi-scale-phi-envelope-ladder (H_634 × H_308 self-similar 연장)
hypothesis: 3 time-scale (gamma 25ms · ultradian 90min · circadian 24h) 의 Φ-envelope 형태가 normalized phase (0~1) 위에서 self-similar — pairwise envelope correlation r > 0.5.
falsifier_floor: scale 별 envelope 형태 분리 (pairwise r < 0.3).
method: 3 scale 각각 N=36 point normalized-phase sweep → Φ-envelope 생성 (gamma single-cosine burst · ultradian H_634 canonical anima_dream_stage projection · circadian H_308 quadratic bump) → 각 envelope 자체 peak 을 τ=0 정렬 (scale-invariant shape) → pairwise Pearson r.
